items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-05-10
items.q: I was waiting for F.L. Trapani brother, jewelry store.

ctx.x: What about the storm? Where were you when they had the big storm there?

Uh, 1915? Yeah, that storm. I was in Plagman, I believe. I was waiting for F.L. Trapani brother, jewelry store. I used to fix cloths. Fix cloths and fix bicycles. They turned the whole shop over to me, you know, the workshop. Used to sell instruments, recordings, guitars. You see, I knew how to tune them up. That's how I learned how to tune them up. Tune up, sell a fella a guitar and I'd tune it for him, you see. If he bought a violin, I'd sell him a violin, tune the violin up for him. Some fellas was just that…
